use_chunkify: use the chunkify decorator to process large tensors in smaller chunks to reduce memory usage during decoding
use_key_cache: use the key_cache decorator to cache function results based on a custom key function for repeated inputs
use_batch_aware_indexing: use batch_aware_indexing to find top-k values from a masked metric tensor across a specified dimension
use_multi_gather: use multi_gather to gather values from a tensor along a dimension using multi-dimensional indices with automatic shape augmentation
use_multi_scatter: use multi_scatter to scatter values into a target tensor at positions specified by multi-dimensional indices
